subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident stay open as a distinct Telegram cross-session hallucination tracker, or be folded into the existing session-routing and duplicate-delivery trackers after preserving its diagnostics?
rationale: The diagnostics prove a real burst and current source preserves adjacent risk paths, but the payload-free report does not identify one root cause or one safe automated fix boundary.

options.title: Split The Fix Boundaries
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers route session isolation, duplicate delivery, and any semantic loop guard to explicit owners or canonical issues.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Trackers
options.body: Close this as superseded only after copying the diagnostic evidence to the relevant canonical session-routing and delivery issues.

options.title: Wait For Fresh Repro
options.body: Leave it stale-needs-info until a reporter supplies raw-enough redacted transcript or live Telegram proof for the irrelevant-output content.

recommendation.title: Split The Fix Boundaries
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers route session isolation, duplicate delivery, and any semantic loop guard to explicit owners or canonical issues.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses Telegram DM policy and reply-delivery behavior where obviyus has adjacent history and prior fixes.
